changelog: v0.4.5: 1) High-Performance Local Piper TTS: replaced heavy MMS-TTS with ultra-lightweight Piper WASM neural models (~15MB per voice, designed for low-power ARM CPUs), cutting synthesis time from 32s down to ~1-2s; 2) Sentence-by-Sentence Local Streaming Queue: implemented streaming audio prefetch queue where Sentence 1 synthesizes and plays in <1s while subsequent sentences buffer in the background; 3) Character-Aligned Default Voices: automatically assigns natural gender/personality-matched default voices to avatars (Maya -> Amy Female, Alex/Ollie -> Ryan Male, Pip -> Kathleen Female, Echo -> Lessac Neutral), while allowing full manual customization via the Settings dropdown.
